orderings-01.statement: Closed breaker uses the default ReadyToTrip → policy is presented counts whose consecutive failures are six → default policy returns true.
orderings-01.fragment: Default `ReadyToTrip` returns true when the number of consecutive failures is more than 5.

orderings-02.statement: Open breaker reaches exactly Timeout with no API activity → clock reaches equality → the stored state autonomously becomes half-open and synchronously calls any installed handler.
orderings-02.fragment: after which the state of `CircuitBreaker` becomes half-open.

orderings-03.statement: A request was sent before Counts cleared → its result arrives after clearing → Counts ignores that result.
orderings-03.fragment: `Counts` ignores the results of the requests sent before clearing.

orderings-04.statement: Open breaker has an unrelated callback holding its mutex → another actor calls Execute before expiry → caller receives a rejection immediately despite contention.
orderings-04.fragment: `Execute` returns an error instantly if `CircuitBreaker` rejects the request.
